original_goal:
[Module: Request Loan | TC-017 | Type: Edge/Boundary | Priority: Medium]
Title: Down payment exactly equals 10% of loan amount passes validation

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/request-loan
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "loan_type": "Home",
  "loan_amount": 250000,
  "down_payment": 25000
}

Preconditions:
  User is on Request Loan page

Steps to Execute:
  1. Select 'Home' loan type
  2. Enter '250000' in Loan Amount
  3. Enter '25000' in Down Payment
  4. Click 'Request Loan'

Expected Result:
  No validation error on Down Payment; form proceeds to credit engine evaluation

Notes from prior verification:
  Down payment equals exactly 10% of the loan (25,000 of 250,000) to exercise the boundary. Exact approval outcome is determined by the credit engine and was not observable in the static DOM.
expected_outcome: No validation error on Down Payment; form proceeds to credit engine evaluation
